fichas.title: Measures of Building Use
fichas.summary: Explains planning-law measures of building use: plot coverage ratio, floor-area ratio, and building mass number. The diagrams express each measure as a relationship to plot area. A full storey is defined by ceiling height and minimum slab level criteria.
uses: Assess permissible building coverage, floor area, and building mass under land-use regulations

dimensions.label: Ceiling height share of floor area for a full storey
dimensions.context: At least this share of the floor area must have the specified ceiling height.
dimensions.ocr_raw:
Ceiling height over 2/3 of the
floor area min 2.30 m

dimensions.label: Minimum ceiling height for a full storey
dimensions.context: Required over at least 2/3 of the floor area, according to MBO.
dimensions.ocr_raw:
Ceiling height over 2/3 of the
floor area min 2.30 m

dimensions.label: Minimum slab level for a full storey
dimensions.context: Minimum slab level, according to MBO; printed with a plus sign.

fichas.title: Housing Area Regulations
fichas.summary: Describes how residential living area is defined and measured. Areas are counted in full, half, or quarter amounts according to room height and space type; subsidiary rooms and certain non-compliant rooms are excluded.
uses: Calculate residential living area for housing-area regulations and housing subsidies

dimensions.label: Ceiling height for full area inclusion
dimensions.context: Rooms and parts of rooms with clear ceiling height of at least this value are included completely.
dimensions.ocr_raw:
Floor areas are included in the calculation either completely (for
rooms and parts of rooms with a clear ceiling height of at least
2 m)

dimensions.label: Lower ceiling-height threshold for half area inclusion
dimensions.context: Rooms and parts of rooms with clear ceiling height of at least this value and less than 2 m are included by half.
dimensions.ocr_raw:
or a half (for rooms and parts of rooms with a clear ceiling
height of at least 1 m and less than 2 m)

dimensions.label: Upper ceiling-height limit for half area inclusion
dimensions.context: Rooms and parts of rooms with clear ceiling height below this value and at least 1 m are included by half.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at least 1 m and less than 2 m

fichas.title: Calculation of Commercial Letting Areas
fichas.summary: Summarizes GIF guidance for calculating leased commercial and office space. It distinguishes areas with exclusive use from communal-use areas, lists exclusions, and specifies how relevant areas and room heights are measured.
uses: Calculate leased commercial and office areas

dimensions.label: Lower room-height threshold for indirectly usable areas
dimensions.context: Indirectly usable areas include areas with room heights between 1.50 m and 2.30 m.

dimensions.context: Indirectly usable areas include areas with room heights between 1.50 m and 2.30 m.
dimensions.ocr_raw:

fichas.title: Floor Areas and Volumes
fichas.summary: Outlines DIN 277 categories for calculating building floor areas and volumes. It defines gross, constructional, and net floor area, breaks net floor area into usable, technical-function, and traffic areas, and describes gross and net built volume calculations.
uses: Calculate floor areas and room volumes in buildings according to DIN 277
